C0701.title: Using Ticket-Snatching Software to Buy Sanxingdui Museum Tickets and Scalp Them at Inflated Prices
keywords: illegally obtaining computer information system data
C0701.summary: Starting in February 2024, Zheng, Zeng, and four other defendants found customers through online promotion, soliciting visitors near the scenic area, and referrals by guides, then used ticket-snatching software in Internet cafes and other venues to buy Sanxingdui Museum tickets. The six defendants unlawfully obtained nearly 2,500 tickets and resold tickets originally priced at 36 to 72 yuan for 100 to 150 yuan, making 102,000 yuan in illegal profit. The court convicted them of illegally obtaining computer information system data, sentencing them to prison terms ranging from three years to one year and six months, suspended, with fines.
